{{Top|leg}}
'''Scara score''' is a rating for specific body mass and musculature that is usually used for recruiting. According to the official field guide for officers within the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]], the recruitment requirements by [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] for the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] included a Scala scoring of 22.x5 or less.
